Real testimony here:

We opened our pool on 5/5…by we opened, I mean we paid someone to open it, and that’s all he did. He removed the cover and added some chemicals… no cleaning, no checking to see if the equipment was working properly, no follow.. by the way, he was not cheap.

We tried for about 3 weeks to clear our pool with no success. The pool was a blueish/greenish color but the water was murky. After dumping a bunch of money in chemicals and many many trips to Leslie’s pool to test the water with no success we finally decided to call a pool company.

I found them on the FB marketplace and gave them a call. The came out the following week and within just 1 visits my pool was crystal clear.

Tina (office person) was extremely helpful and pleasant.

Matthew was super informative and helpful.
